Asks you on Telegram, with a button per answer, and waits. The items go on through the port of the button you press, or through timeout. Link Telegram in Settings first.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `telegram.ask` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `timeout`, and one per value of **Buttons** (`buttons`) |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Question (`message`) | text | no | `Go ahead?` | {{field}} puts in an item's field, e.g. {{question}}. Several items make a line each; one answer goes for all of them. |
| Format (`format`) | text | no | `text` | text: sent as written. html: Telegram's tags work, such as &lt;b&gt;, &lt;i&gt;, &lt;code&gt; and &lt;a href="…"&gt;; item fields are escaped. One of `text`, `html`. |
| Buttons (`buttons`) | list of text | no | `Yes`, `No` | One per line, up to 10, at most 40 characters each. Each button is an output port of the same name. |
| Timeout (`timeout`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | How long to wait for a press before the items go through timeout, e.g. 30m or 24h. At most the instance's longest wait, 7 days unless an admin changed it. |
